The integration seat traced the cause: `cente-b3`, a genuinely live session it had mistakenly dispatched into the same worktree earlier tonight (not a stale/closed session as this lane had been told), was sequentially working #440 -> #611 -> #554 in parallel with this lane the whole time -- which is also the real explanation for why #440 and #611 were already ahead of the handoff's assumed state when this lane picked up the lane.
